description:
Create a new AI/ML Primitives benchmark to test cross-platform SQL-based AI/ML
functions. This benchmark covers built-in AI functions that execute within the
data warehouse, NOT external ML frameworks or vector search (covered separately).

Focus areas:
- LLM/Generative AI functions (Snowflake Cortex, BigQuery ML, Databricks AI)
- Sentiment analysis, text classification, summarization
- Entity extraction, translation
- SQL-invokable ML predictions (not model training)

This differs from the existing Vector Search benchmark which focuses on
embedding storage and similarity search. This benchmark tests AI function
invocation performance and output quality consistency.
